messages:
Alicia (AE): Heads-up — Deerfield wants a 1-week POC. They plan to bring a custom adapter bundle (df-adapt-14b-q4_k.tar.gz). Need compat + security answers before kickoff.
Ravi (SE): Can you confirm exact variant and tokenizer? Sometimes these adapters rely on a custom BPE.
Alicia (AE): They said 'df-adapt-14b (q4_k_mixed), tokenizer attached (vocab.json + merges.txt)'. Also asked whether we support prefix KV cache across adapter layers.
Mei (Solutions Engineer): We can host the adapter but need to validate tokenization mapping and check whether adapter injects extra states into the transformer loop. KV cache should work if adapter only modifies linear projection dims; if it mutates attention layout we need a shim.
Ravi (SE): Running quick compatibility check now. Command: 
```
redwoodctl validate-model --bundle s3://deerfield/poc/df-adapt-14b-v2.tar.gz --checks tokenizer,kvcache,ops
```
Initial output: "error: fused_layernorm op missing on cuda-kernel path" — fallback to slower kernel. Investigating.
Jason (Infra): If we need a different kernel set we can spin a canary on a dedicated pool. That'll take ~1-3h to provision + config. No big deal but call it out to customer.
Alicia (AE): Deerfield expects 180ms p95 for 512 tokens. Is that realistic on quantized 14B?
Mei (Solutions Engineer): Typical p95 on A10G/GPU class with q4_k is ~130-170ms depending on single-request vs micro-batching and whether KV caching hits. For strict 180ms SLO we'll want dedicated nodes and to enable prefix cache.
Alicia (AE): Pricing ask: estimate cost for 5-day POC with 2 dedicated nodes + canary + infra ops support.
Mei (Solutions Engineer): Ballpark: $850/day in infra plus ops time. We can offer first 2 days complimentary, then metered. Also can include a short perf-run report.
Nora (Legal): We've got a vendor security questionnaire from Deerfield. They require KMS (customer-managed key) support, audit log retention 12 months, and a data deletion clause. Can someone upload the doc?
Alicia (AE): Uploaded to the deal folder: https://s3.company/deals/deerfield/vendor_q_2026.pdf
infra-bot: Automated security scan result: 4 items — (1) model artifact signed? NO, (2) KMS policy missing service principal, (3) audit retention default=90d < requested 365d, (4) transport layer ok.
Jason (Infra): We can add a KMS policy entry quickly. Artifact signing requires CI change on their side or us to accept unsigned during POC under exception.
Nora (Legal): For HSM: enterprise HSM support requires Private deployment. We'll note that in questionnaire. For hosted POC we can offer a dedicated CMK but not HSM-backed keys by default.
Ravi (SE): Quick follow-up on compatibility: after building runtime with `--prefer-fallback-fused=layernorm` the model loads and tokenization tests pass. Perf baseline locally: ~160ms p95 single-shot with KV cache enabled.
Mei (Solutions Engineer): Action list: (1) Ravi to run canary on dedicated pool and attach perf logs; (2) Jason to provision short-lived dedicated pool + patch KMS policy; (3) Nora to complete vendor questionnaire answers and flag HSM constraint; (4) Alicia to confirm POC schedule and pricing with customer.
Alicia (AE): I'll propose Wed kickoff and explain the two-day complimentary window. Also will surface HSM constraint.
Jason (Infra): I'll start infra ticket now and post runbook link.
Ravi (SE): Will post `redwoodctl validate` logs into the ticket after canary. If we see any op-level mismatches I'll open an infra PR.
Nora (Legal): I'll draft the questionnaire replies and share in the folder by EOD. Escalate to sales ops if Deerfield insists on HSM for hosted.
Alicia (AE): Thanks team — please ping here when canary passes. Reopen thread if anything urgent comes up. :sparkles:
